Personalised Face Photo Pint Glass – “Your Name’s Pint – Hands Off!” – Funny Gift with Your Photo
SKU: FOXY-UVDTF-PFHOPG-01   Price: £13.99   Made 9 Oct 2026

HOW TO PRINT
- UV DTF transfer for the 20oz nonic pint (owner's rule: glass is always UV DTF).
- Artboard = the 90 x 130 mm print area + 3 mm bleed. The design sits in the middle; everything else is clear glass (no background).
- Apply 10 mm below the rim, centred on the front of the glass.
- Layers: Artwork + CUT (red 0.25 mm trim line, 2.5 mm corners). Text is live; the text ids match the website fields: Face photo upload, Name, Bottom line (optional).
- PHOTO: the dashed oval marks where the customer's photo goes. Cut the face/pet out (background removed), add a ~1.5 mm black outline, 300 dpi.
